name: Extinguish the Firegut
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
We must strike at our enemies before they strike at us!

I'll make this brief, soldier.

The Firegut ogres of the Burning Steppes are allies of the Blackrock orcs. They work closely with those vile orcs, keeping the mineral rich Dreadmaul Rock guarded and the supply lines open at all times.

Leave your mark, adventurer. Cripple their forces and return to me when the job is done.

<Oralius grabs at the air and makes a choking motion.>

I WILL KILL YOU, WINKY!
narrative.objectives: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.
narrative.offerRewardText: Outstanding, soldier! The orcs and ogres will be reeling from this blow for minutes, maybe even hours!
narrative.requestItemsText: There is not nearly enough blood on your uniform, soldier!

quests.name: Gor'tesh the Brute Lord
quests.objectiveText: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock.

quests.name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
quests.objectiveText: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock.
